## Checklist

- [ ] It works on PHP 7.4 and on PHP 8.x.
- [ ] It works with MySQL 5.6+ and MariaDB 10.1+ (or the change does not touch the database).
- [ ] New or changed text is in English and, where the admin or a theme shows it, in the language files too.
- [ ] I updated the docs (README, INSTALL, UPGRADE, CHANGELOG or docs/) where the change needs it.
- [ ] Every file I added says where it comes from; third-party code keeps its license and is listed in NOTICE.
- [ ] The JavCMS notice at the top of each changed JavCMS file is kept.
- [ ] No passwords, keys, personal data or real site data; test data and screenshots are safe for work.
- [ ] I agree that my contribution is published under the JavCMS Community License 1.0.
